name: modus
description: Core modus plugin: /modus:init (set up a repo from the catalog), the capture watcher skill (proposes reusable configs when it spots corrections, repeated chores, or permission friction in modus-initialized repos), the decision-watcher skill (records life/project moments straight into the journal of the user's personal knowledge base, ungated, on machines where one is configured), and the SessionStart sync that refreshes each repo's committed house-rule copies in .claude/rules/modus/ (and, for one more release, still publishes to ~/.claude/modus/rules/ for repos on the old import lines).
